question: Over what fourfold task is the guru authorized, and how does that authority arise?
premises: Therefore the guru is authorized over the fourfold task of creation, maintenance, impurity (concealment), and dissolution of the pure realities.
That authorization arises together with union (yojana) and grace (anugraha) — the joining of the paths and the conferral that completes it.
inference: Guru-authority is the fourfold cosmic act (emission, maintenance, concealment, dissolution) exercised through the joining of the paths and grace — the same four tasks the Lord performs.
uncertainties: the four tasks are named compactly (sṛṣṭi-sthiti-mala-atyaya) and their exact mapping to the Lord's five acts is a doctrinal question Jayaratha settles; kept to the text's four here
plain_english: So the guru is authorized over the fourfold task — creation and maintenance of the pure realities, their impurity and their dissolution — through the joining (of the paths) and grace.
